evidence: The Si substrates were 6 X 20 mm plates cleaved from 0.4mm-thick p-type (B doped, resistivity = 3--4 n em) Si wafers. The substrates were degreased with successive rinses in trichloroethane, acetone, methanol, and distilled water before insertion into the vacuum system where they were resistively heated to 775 K for 30 min and subsequently annealed at a series of progressively higher temperatures between 775 and 1075 K for :::Amin at each temperature. The final cleaning step consisted of flash heating to 1275 K for 3 s.
